notes.title: 🔤 9 Language Update! 🌍🎙️
notes.notes:
Hey Workshopers! 🛠️

We're bringing you a language update to make your gameplay even more immersive and accessible to players worldwide! 🌎✨

🆕 What's New?

✅ Text translations– new language versions for the interface, descriptions, and dialogues throughout the game. Now, even more players can enjoy the full experience!

✅ Voice-over translations– we've added dubbing in selected languages to make missions and interactions feel even more realistic. Hear the new level of immersion! 🎙️🎧

Supported Languages:
- English
- Polish
- Japanese
- Korean
- Spanish
- Latin American Spanish
- Italian
- French
- German


🌍 Accessibility for Everyone – as the game evolves, we want it to be understandable and enjoyable for players across the globe.

📢 Got a language suggestion? Let us know, and who knows – it might appear in the next update!

🎮 Jump into the game and explore the new translations! 🔥

~VR Factory Team

notes.title: 🔧 Bug Fixing Update! 🚀
notes.notes:
Hey Workshopers! 🛠️

A new update packed with fixes and improvements!

Check out what's changed:

✅ Mission completion animation– instantly see how much you earned!

✅ Improved immersion– pick up the package again before cutting it open.

✅ Better screw highlighting– now with arrows 🔼🔽 to show if they’re screwed in or out.

✅ New tray shape– improved grip for the tray and objects.

✅ Update info board– always stay up to date with the latest changes!

✅ Larger item selection area– easier interaction with the computer.

✅ Object teleportation– no more getting stuck inside the package outline!
__


🎮 Jump into the game and check out the new fixes! 💪🔥

~VR Factory Team

notes.title: 🔧 Bug Fixing Update! 🚀
notes.notes:
Hey Workshop Enthusiasts! 🛠️🎨

A new update full of fixes and improvements has just landed in the game! We want to make your experience even better, so we’ve fine-tuned some important gameplay aspects:

✅ Better interaction– increased remote grab range and item slot placement to make interactions more intuitive. 🤏

✅ Easier assembly– the first element to insert is now clearly marked, so you always know where to start. 🧩

✅ More readable progress bars– now in green, so you’ll never think you’re doing something wrong! 💚

✅ Clearer stars– black stars on a green background = better visibility. ⭐

✅ Returner system fix– single-piece items will no longer fall off the map. 🔄

✅ More satisfying polishing– brush balancing adjusted for smoother work. 🛠️

✅ Updated store links– check out our other games and try them for free! 🎮

__


Thank you for your feedback and support! 💚 Let us know what you think about this update and what else you'd love to see in the game! 🚀

Good luck in the workshop, and have fun!

~VR Factory Team🚀
